description: Central Province - By laws relating to the Kadugannawa Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of new by-laws (regulations) for the Kadugannawa Urban Council relating to seizure of astray animals and obtaining information for levying taxes. The content establishes legal frameworks, regulatory procedures, and compliance requirements, which falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While it mentions government officials (Sarath Ekanayake as Minister), the core content is regulatory in nature rather than focusing on government personnel changes or structural reorganization.
